item.description:
**Toolbox now lives in the menu bar.** The hammer icon opens a panel with the full toolbox — pick a tool, drop files in, run it — so you never need a window. Switch on **Hide Dock icon** in **Settings → General** and Toolbox leaves the Dock entirely: no Dock icon, no app switcher entry, no window at login. It takes effect immediately, no relaunch, and the menu bar icon stays available so there's always a way back.
**Open Toolbox at login** is in the same place, for either mode.
Everything else is unchanged: files are still processed entirely on your Mac.
[Full changes](https://github.com/lazzyms/toolbox/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0)

First public release.
**Tools**
- **Remove PDF Password** — save a decrypted copy of a PDF you know the password for. Text stays selectable and searchable. - **Convert Image Format** — HEIC ⇄ PNG ⇄ JPEG ⇄ TIFF, and reads RAW. - **Compress Images** — lossless (format-preserving) or lossy with a quality slider. Never returns a file bigger than the original. - **Resize Images** — fit inside a box, longest side, percentage, or exact pixels. EXIF rotation is baked in, so iPhone photos come out upright.
Drag in as many files as you like; they process in parallel and one bad file never stops the batch. Originals are never modified and nothing is overwritten.
**Installing**
Download the DMG, open it, drag **Toolbox** to Applications. This build isn't notarized by Apple, so the first launch needs one extra step:
> **Right-click** Toolbox in Applications → **Open** → **Open**
That's once per machine; afterwards it's a normal double-click.
**Updates**
Toolbox updates itself from here on. It asks on first launch whether to check automatically, then checks daily — or use **Toolbox → Check for Updates…** any time. Every download is verified against a cryptographic signature before installing. Your files are processed on-device and never uploaded.
